test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If south is changed to north-west, north-west is changed to east, east is changed to south-west and so on, which direction is north-east changed to?
solution: Given:- 1) South is changed to North-West (135 º clockwise rotation) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb11b474525f16a7f3cc6e48cfa59e0b675a697b2b1320cf67d1dd5d0573afd0.png] 2) North-West is changed to East (135 º clockwise rotation)
